name: What is the difference between framed and frameless custom cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between framed and frameless custom cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both frameless and framed cabinets offer strong durability, but they differ in construction style and usable interior space. Framed cabinetry features a solid wood face frame on the front of the cabinet box, offering a traditional aesthetic and sturdy hinge mounting. Frameless cabinetry, often called full-access or European-style, eliminates the face frame. This practical tradeoff provides slightly wider drawer openings and easier access to the interior, making it well-suited for modern, streamlined kitchens or tight spaces where every millimeter of interior clearance counts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framed cabinets have a front face frame for a classic look, while frameless cabinets offer full-access interiors and slightly wider drawer space.
